newsitem.title: UK: British Aerospace shares slip on French worry.
newsitem.headline: British Aerospace shares slip on French worry.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace dipped on Monday after the French Socialist election victory cast doubt over the planned privatisation of Thomson-CSF and the wider consolidation of the European defense industry.

British Aerospace is one of a group bidding for Thomson-CSF assets led by Lagardere. The privatisation was set by the outgoing government for later this month and was expected to accelerate a reorganisation of Europe's defence industry.
By 1345 GMT British Aerospace was down 14 pence at 12.32 stg on the London bourse, although turnover was subdued at just over 772,000. Analysts blamed doubts created by the poll outcome.

"The stock has been a bit wobbly over the French elections and you could put this (fall) down to the view that the rationalisation of the European defense industry might now take a little longer," said Zafar Khan at stockbroker Socgen.
The Socialists have yet to make any statement on the French privatisation schedule.
